summary: Iteration 9: full backend + frontend verification of Online Payment (Stripe) feature end-to-end. 15/15 backend tests pass. Portal mobile 390px Richiesta dialog shows correct Pagamento section (portal-pay-online '92,00 € (incl. bollo 2,00 €)' + portal-pay-studio). Doctor Schedule dialog exposes schedule-price-* and schedule-billing-{holder,tax_code,vat_number,address,note} + schedule-save-btn and persists on GET/PUT /api/settings/schedule. Doctor Cash Register shows a paid online entry (92,00 €) with cash-receipt-{id} that downloads 'Ricevuta_1-2026_Aurora_Ricci.pdf', and the refund row (-92,00 €) 'Rimborso · Prima visita'. Cancellations list displays 'Pagamento online di 92,00 € rimborsato in automatico'. Stripe webhook invalid signature → 400. DELETE /api/payments/{id} on online entry → 409. POST /api/payments with method=online rejected 422 (CashPanel Literal restriction). Online quote correctly disables online when price=0.

design_issues.screen: Portal RequestDialog (parent) and ScheduleDialog date field
issues: <input type='date'> uses browser default picker instead of shadcn Calendar component (per project guideline).

Default seed address value is the literal string '[Indirizzo fiscale]' which, since it is not empty, bypasses the receipt's '[da completare nelle impostazioni]' placeholder and will print the raw bracketed text on the PDF receipt. Suggest storing empty string so the receipt fallback triggers, or seeding a real address.

action_items: (minor) Consider replacing <input type='date'> in portal RequestDialog and ScheduleDialog with a shadcn Calendar for consistency.
(minor) Seed billing.address with an empty string (not '[Indirizzo fiscale]') so build_receipt falls back to the '[da completare nelle impostazioni]' placeholder, or supply a real fiscal address.
critical_code_review_comments: billing.py checkout(): 'request_doc' is only reached after check_request validates the slot — good atomicity. Hold is marked by writing status=awaiting_payment and hold_until; free_slots filters it. The MAX_HOLDS=3 guard uses hold_until>=now which allows DoS if a parent spams checkout (holds eat 3 slots for 35 min). Acceptable, flagged.
billing.py fulfil() reads the payment_transactions atomically with find_one_and_update filter {payment_status:{$ne:'paid'}}; idempotent across webhook+status call. Good.
billing.py receipt_filter requires method=='online' AND refund_no!=null AND refund_of==null — this blocks any attempt to retrieve the negative refund row's PDF, correct.
scheduling.online_quote marks online=True only if a tax_code OR vat_number is set; with the seed billing both are present, so the online option appears for every service with price>0.

portal_flow.cancel_appointment calls refund_online BEFORE flipping status to annullato — so if the Stripe Refund.create raises, status is NOT changed and the visit stays bookable. Correct ordering, but note the refund_online writes a 'refunded_at' on the payment doc _before_ raising nothing (there is no partial state since Stripe failure raises before the update). OK.

Payment model has stamp:float default 0 (not Optional) and server.PaymentIn's Literal rejects 'online' at API level — so cashier can never create a fake 'online' row. Good defense in depth with the delete 409 guard.

success_rate.frontend: All targeted selectors (portal-pay-*, schedule-price-*, schedule-billing-*, cash-method-total-online, cash-receipt-*, cancellation-refund-*) present and functional
